entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:1
segments: As dead flies cause the perfumer's ointment to stink [and] ferment; [so] heavier more rare than wisdom and than honor is a little foolishness.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:2
segments: A man's heart [is] at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:3
segments: Yes also, in the way a fool walks, his heart fails; and he says to all [that] he [is] a fool.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:4
segments: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, do not leave your place; for yielding quiets great sinners.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:5
segments: There is an evil I have seen under the sun, sins which comes from the ruler's face;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:6
segments: foolishness is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:7
segments: I have seen servants on horses and princes walking as servants on the earth.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:8
segments: He who digs a pit shall fall into it; and whoever breaks a hedge, a snake shall bite him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:9
segments: Whoever removes stones shall be hurt with them. He who splits wood shall be endangered by it.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:10
segments: If the iron is blunt, and he does not whet the edge, then he must put more strength to [it]. But wisdom [is] profitable to direct.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:11
segments: Surely the snake will bite without enchantment; and a babbler [is] no better.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:12
segments: The words of a wise mouth [are] gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:13
segments: The beginning of the words of his mouth [is] foolishness; and the end of his talk [is] wicked madness.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:14
segments: A fool also makes many words; a man knows not what they shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:15
segments: The labor of fools wearies him, because he does not know [how] to go to the city.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:16
segments: Woe to you, O land, when your king [is] a child and your leaders eat in the morning.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:17
segments: Blessed [are] you, O land, when your king [is] the son of nobles, and your leaders eat in [due] time, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:18
segments: By slothfulness the building decays; and through lowering of the hands the house leaks.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:19
segments: Bread [is] made for laughter, and wine makes merry; but silver answers all [things].

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:20
segments: Do not curse a king, no, not in your thought; and do not curse the rich in your bedroom; for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which has wings shall tell the matter.
